purpose: Machine-readable feature list for the Components Marketplace harness

features.description: Cart stock clamp, volume tiers, mixed-line quantity integrity, cart-fetch gating, and P2 storefront QA (#368 / PR #364)
features.validation: initializeQuantities uses available stock only; mixed-line mock cart reduce preserves backorder; hasFetchedCart only after successful refresh; P2: SSR-safe guest checkout gate, dashboard CTAs, auth footer links, Lei currency, category counts + View all navigate; pnpm verify + runtime evidence
evidence: store/cartStore.ts hasFetchedCart only after successful refresh
pnpm verify:full PASS (prior cart P1 evidence)
preview API: PUT stock=5/backorder=10 then POST -2 -> stock=3 backorder=10
browser http://127.0.0.1:3000/order-summary Payment Summary Subtotal 999.99 Lei after fetch (no stale skeleton/zero)

features.validation: AGENTS.md answers the fresh-session questions and links to focused topic docs
A new session can read current focus, blocked items, and verification baseline

features.description: Record durable design decisions in DECISIONS.md
features.validation: Important architectural and harness choices are written down outside chat
A fresh checkout can run one initialization command before feature work

features.description: Keep only one task active at a time
features.validation: WIP=1 is enforced in issue pickup, feature list policy, and lifecycle rules

features.description: Drive autonomous work from GitHub Issues
features.validation: `ready-for-agent` issues exist, an `in-progress` claim state exists, and the loop can pick a single issue without duplication

features.description: Prevent premature victory with executable done gates
features.validation: Agents must run static, targeted, and runtime checks before saying done
Each coding task records a sprint contract, verification evidence, risks, and handoff

features.description: Leave a clean state at the end of every session
features.validation: Clean-state checklist covers verification, git status, temporary artifacts, progress, feature state, and PR evidence

features.description: Keep the local loop controller self-healing and observable
features.validation: A dead legacy lock is recovered, a live owner is protected, long runs report running, and a successful poll records a healthy heartbeat

features.description: Route CI and PR review failures into the same-PR repair loop
features.validation: Only current-head failed CI, actionable Qodo review, or trusted changes-requested signals are selected once; evaluator handoff requires successful CI
